instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/risky_setup.step in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Machine all safe holes and maintain at least 3 mm clearance from fixtures. Tool definitions: use T1 and T2 drilling tools sized for the safe holes, respect holder clearance, and skip collision-risk holes. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-15.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
